Concert Piece for Soli, Choir, Piano obbligato and Orchestra

history.p: In April 1888, Gade wrote to Breitkopf & Härtel that he had finished a new work for choir, piano obbligato and orchestra, but in April the following year he still had not finished the instrumentation. "Der Strom" had its first performance in Copenhagen in December 1889, but the score was not published until after Gade's death.
